latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Tangential pos_hardware-adjacent overlap: HAT's mounts can hold POS terminals, payment devices, or kiosks (including Genius hardware) — it is more often a complementary accessory vendor than a head-to-head competitor.

latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Not typically a competitive-displacement conversation; relevant mainly if a prospect asks about mounting/enclosure compatibility for hardware.
